title: Heeralal Pannalal
desc: Two clumsy officers Heera Lal and Panna Lal have their lives turned into utter turmoil and hilarious chaos when they find out that another pair of men bearing their exact names have moved into town.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.

title: New Delhi
desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Panni wreaks havoc in the lives of Manu and Tulsi, forcing them to leave the village. Years later, they return to exact a not-so-sweet revenge upon Panni.

title: Kal Ki Awaz
desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.
